sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static, content-heavy product/detail page with stacked images, headings, text blocks, and footer-like link areas. There are no clearly drawn controls such as hamburger icons, dropdown indicators, tabs, accordions, form fields, search boxes, modal triggers, counters, or load-more affordances. Any JavaScript behavior beyond basic link navigation would be speculative from the sketches alone; the layouts mainly imply responsive reflow rather than explicit interactive widgets.
